svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a thick pale oxide buries three metal lines, its top higher over the lines than over the gaps. After it the oxide is polished flat, leaving a layer of it over the tops of the lines.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a thick pale oxide buries three metal lines, its top higher over the lines than over the gaps. After it the oxide is polished flat, leaving a layer of it over the tops of the lines.
svg.text: The oxide is polished flat, leaving a
controlled thickness over the metal lines.
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
